CQMS

Uniform orders

Ask for what you need below; it goes into the next order. CQMS places the order and marks it arrived. Pay with the QR code and upload the payment screenshot; once CQMS approves the payment you can collect the item and mark it received.

Only the CQMS (and the administrator) can place orders, approve payments and change prices.

Order

Prices

Price of one of each item in rupees, used for the bill. One price for all beret sizes. A placed order keeps the prices it was placed at.

Where cadets pay

The QR code and account details every cadet sees when they pay for uniform items. Stays the same until you change it.

Schedule not assigned

0

Cadets (matching the filters) without a timetable yet. These cadets are not assumed to be unavailable.

Timetables are set by the administrator and POCs with “Edit timetables”. A missing schedule means “not assigned/unknown”, not “unavailable”. 3rd years are left out of availability. Anyone can view this page; only approved editors can record call-outs or change cycle details.

Attendance register

Every parade in the dates you pick, cadet by cadet. P present, L late, A absent, E excused (reported or on leave), blank not marked.

How is it done?

Each cadet: everyone is marked separately (forms, fees). Once for the group: they do one thing together, one mark for all.

Posted on the notice board with a notification to everyone the task is for. Anyone can volunteer until the places are full. Nobody can step out alone: a senior takes them off, and they are told. The task then tracks only the volunteers.

Screenshot (optional)

A ticket, a medical paper or similar. Only sergeants and above (and the administrator) can see it, and it is deleted after the parade.

A sergeant or above (or the administrator) approves it. You can change or withdraw it until requests close, 30 minutes before reporting time.

    Leave

    Ask for leave

    For several days away: home, a camp, exams, illness. Parades on those days don't count against you once a sergeant or above approves it.

    Screenshot (optional)

    A ticket or a letter. Only sergeants and above see it, and it is deleted once the leave is over.

    Data

    Backups

    Make a copy of all the shared data before a big change. Copies are kept for 30 days. Restoring one replaces everything for everyone; a copy of the data as it is now is kept first.
